It stayed at 3/11, improving over 261c on overall coverage (0.731 -> 0.779) and calibration error (0.090 -> 0.041), but worsening cointegration (0.55 -> 0.452), level KS (16 -> 11), and jump realism. Postmortem showed the scale head did learn the target residual scale reasonably, but both predicted and target residual scales were negatively correlated with vol-of-vol at the window level. That means the residualized decomposition around frozen 260e is misaligned with the regime-sensitive scenario objective.
